wyoming.name: Wyoming
wyoming.seoTitle: Psychological thrillers for Sheridan, Wyoming | AJ Ghost
wyoming.seoDescription: Sheridan, Wyoming: a free night-shift story, Pump Six, then HUNTED free on BookFunnel. The Ryan Kane Series is not set here.
wyoming.intro: Wyoming keeps its nights long, and Sheridan is the town on this shelf. It is a small ranch and railroad community at the foot of the Bighorn Mountains, with I-90 along the valley. The page below is for readers there who want a short psychological thriller, not a claim that The Ryan Kane Series happens in the state. Pump Six, the embedded story, is companion fiction with its own free-read address. HUNTED, the prequel, is free on BookFunnel. Fractured Ground is on Kindle only. Digital Ascent, book three, has a free advance copy. Other towns stay off this list until a page is actually published. Start in Sheridan if that is your night, or open the free reads if you want the stories without a city around them.
